zh-CN: 确认发布
en-US: Confirm publication

zh-CN: 发布后该公告将对读者可见，确定发布吗？
en-US: Publishing will make this announcement visible to readers. Publish it?

zh-CN: 确认撤回
en-US: Confirm withdrawal

zh-CN: 撤回后该公告将不再对读者展示，可稍后重新发布。确定撤回吗？
en-US: Withdrawing will hide this announcement from readers. You can publish it again later. Withdraw it?

zh-CN: 建立修订草稿
en-US: Create revision draft

zh-CN: 将基于历史版本建立可编辑草稿，保存不会直接发布。确定建立吗？
en-US: Create an editable draft from the historical version? Saving does not publish it.

zh-CN: 请刷新后重试，操作标识缺失。
en-US: Refresh and retry: the operation identity is missing.

zh-CN: 包含不可直接修改的公告字段，请刷新后重试。
en-US: Protected announcement fields cannot be changed directly.

zh-CN: 公告发布尚未启用：需要先完成受众授权与可靠分发接入。
en-US: Announcement publication is not enabled until audience authorization and reliable delivery are installed.

zh-CN: 公告不存在或无权访问。
en-US: The announcement does not exist or is not accessible.

zh-CN: 当前状态不能执行此操作，请刷新查看最新状态。
en-US: This action is unavailable in the current state. Refresh to see the latest state.

zh-CN: 此公告已有历史版本，不能删除。
en-US: This announcement has historical versions and cannot be deleted.

zh-CN: 公告输入不符合要求。
en-US: The announcement input is invalid.

zh-CN: 公告标题最多256个字符。
en-US: The announcement title must not exceed 256 characters.

zh-CN: 请通过公告受控操作完成修改。
en-US: Use an authorized announcement command to make changes.

zh-CN: 附件不可用，请确认已上传完成且属于当前租户。
en-US: The attachment is unavailable. Check that its upload is finalized in this tenant.

zh-CN: 免审发布需要选择免审模式并填写免审原因。
en-US: Choose exemption mode and provide an exemption reason.

zh-CN: 发布前请补全公告标题和正文。
en-US: Complete the announcement title and content before publication.

zh-CN: 预约时间必须晚于当前时间，请重新选择。
en-US: Choose a scheduled time in the future.

zh-CN: 有效期不能早于发布时间或知悉截止时间，请调整。
en-US: The expiry must cover publication and the acknowledgement deadline.

zh-CN: 没有符合授权规则的接收人，请调整通知对象。
en-US: No authorized recipients matched. Update the audience.

zh-CN: 审批依据尚未就绪，请核对审批进展。
en-US: Approval authority is not ready. Check approval progress.

zh-CN: 发布授权已变化，请重新核对范围并提交。
en-US: Publication authorization changed. Review the audience and submit again.

zh-CN: 通知桥接尚未启用，请联系租户管理员完成配置后再发布。
en-US: The notification bridge is disabled. Ask the tenant administrator to enable it before publication.
